status: v0.2 with the trading account-age minimum set to 0 days for the closed test (restore 7 before wider release)

currencies.season_points: league score, never spent, resets each August
currencies.coins: earned 1 per point scored; spent on packs and swaps; never affects ranking

free_rewards.starter_pack: once on sign-up: 5 players in squad shape, same tier, one guaranteed stronger card
free_rewards.weekly_free_pack: one player pack per gameweek, unlocked by confirming that week's actions

compensation.player_leaves_pl: free swap pack of same rarity
compensation.club_relegated: free swap pack per card, same rarity
compensation.retired: free swap pack of same rarity

pack_odds: to be set; must be logged per opening and visible on the pack
never: paid purchases of any kind in the MVP test

team_of_the_week.comment: After each gameweek is final: the best GK, DEF, two MIDs and FWD become a numbered edition. The top award_top_percent of that week's players each get a Team of the Week pack. Earned only: never sold.

trading.comment: Card-for-card only, between players who share a mini-league. No Coins, money or gifting.
